definitions.full: H6828. tsaphon I. צָפוֺן 153 noun feminine Isa 43:6 north (as the hidden, dark ; compare Thes Lewy Fremdw. 188 f. ; perhaps Phoenician צפל north ); — absolute ׳צ Jeremiah 26:26 +, צָפֹ֫נָה northward Gen 13:14 +, oftener צָפ֫וֺנָה Jer 3:12 +, also צָפ֫וֺנָה = צָפוֺן 1:13 + (after prepositions and stative construct; compare Ges § 90e ); construct לְ מִצְּפוֺן Josh 8:11 +, also מִצְּפוֺן 19:14 Gi (compare Benn; van d. H. Baer ׳מִצָּ ), לְ מִצְּפ֫וֺנָה Judg 21:19 ; ( ׳צ occurs oftenest in Ezekiel [46 t.], Joshua [25 t.], Jeremiah [25 t.], Daniel [9 t.]); — north (opposite south, east, west) Gen 13:14 ; 28:14 (both J), Exod 27:11 (P), +; צ ׳מְּאַת north side 26:20 ; Josh 15:5 + (see מֵּאָה ); so צ ׳צֶלַיע Exod 26:35 , הַצּ ׳רוּחַ Ezek 42:17 , compare צָפ֫וֺנָה הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עַליֶֿרֶךְ 2Kin 16:14 ; צ ׳גְּבוּל Num 34:7 , 9 north boundary ; צ ׳יַתְכְּתֵי remote parts of north Isa 14:13 (as divine abode), Ezek 38:6 , 15 + (see [ יַרְכָה ]); הַצּ ׳שַׁעַר 40:35 +, צ ׳מֶּתַח 42:2 ; צ ׳רוּחַ Ezekiel 25:23 north wind , and so ׳צ alone Song 4:16 ; toward the north is צָפ֫וֺנָה Josh 13:3 +? אֶלצָֿפוֺן Eccl 1:6 , ׳אֶלהַֿצּ Ezek 42:1 , אֶלהַֿצָּפ֫וֺנָה 8:14 , לַצָּפוֺן 40:23 , הַצָּפוֺן דֶּרֶךְ 40:20 , ׳ד צָפ֫וֺנָה 8:5 (twice in verse) +, etc.; especially (in Jeremiah, Ezekiel, etc.) of quarter whence invaders were to come, e. g. Assyrians Isa 14:31 , compare Zeph 2:13 , Babylonians Jer 6:1 , 22 ; 15:12 ; 46:20 , 24 ( ׳עַםצֿ ), 47:2 , Ezek 26:7 , Cyrus against Babylonian Isa 41:25 , compare Jer 50:3 , 9 , 41 ; 51:48 ; more vaguely, 1:14-15 , ( צ ׳מַמְלְכוֺת ), 4:6 ; 10:22 ; 13:20 ; 25:9 , 26 ( הַצּ ׳מַלְכֵי ); of Gog's host Ezek 38:6 , 15 ; 39:2 ; צ ׳נְסִיכֵי 32:30 (apparently of nearer [Aramaean?] princes); צ ׳אֶרֶץ Jer 31:8 is region of Carchemish, but Zech 2:10 ; 6:6 , 8 (twice in verse) of Babylon; צ ׳מֵאֶרֶץ (sometimes + other countries) the exiles and dispersed are to return Jer 3:18 ; 16:15 = 23:8 ; 31:8 , compare Isa 43:6 ; 49:12 ; הַצּ ׳מֶלֶךְ Dan 11:6-7 , 8 , 11 , 13 , 15 , 40 denotes successive Seleucidae.
